subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• In 2018, marine biologist Dr. Tara Sengupta studied the differences in diving depth between humpback whales and other cetacean species.
• Her research team tracked all whale species within a 50-mile radius of the California coast.
• Humpback whales typically dive to depths of around 600 feet, which places them in the intermediate diving category.
• 284 of the 320 whales observed were shallow divers (dolphins and gray whales), reaching depths under 400 feet (shallower than humpbacks).
• 18 of the 320 whales observed were deep divers (sperm whales and beaked whales), reaching depths greater than 1,200 feet (deeper than humpbacks).
prompt: The student wants to emphasize how deep humpback whales dive relative to other cetaceans. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: At around 600 feet, which places them in the intermediate diving category, humpback whales dive deeper than most but not all of the cetaceans within 50 miles of the California coast.
choices.B: Marine biologist Dr. Tara Sengupta determined that humpback whales, at around 600 feet, are intermediate divers, and several other cetaceans within a 50-mile range are deep divers.
choices.C: Of the 320 cetaceans within 50 miles of the California coast, 284 are shallow divers (dolphins and gray whales), reaching depths under 400 feet.
choices.D: While most cetaceans within 50 miles of the California coast are shallow or deep divers, humpback whales are intermediate divers due to their diving depth of 600 feet.

explanation:
Choice A is the best answer. Noting that humpback whales (600 feet) dive deeper than most cetaceans within 50 miles of the California coast, the sentence emphasizes how deep humpback whales dive relative to other cetaceans.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect. The sentence explains that the majority of cetaceans near the California coast are shallow divers; it doesn't indicate humpback whale diving depth or emphasize how deep they dive relative to other cetaceans.
